2. Categories outside the user’s permission must be completely hidden from view.

Any category outside the user’s permission must be completely hidden from the screen.
The category dropdown and search filters must show only the categories the user is allowed to view.

chunks.title: 🎯Purpose
chunks.heading: Section 1: 🧾Overview › 🎯Purpose
chunks.text:
This document explains the requirement to show FPO and FPPO only for the categories a user has permission to access.
Currently, the system shows all categories FPO and FPPO even if the user is not category permission.

chunks.title: 🏢Business Requirement:
chunks.heading: Section 1: 🧾Overview › 🏢Business Requirement:
chunks.text:
Currently, the system displays all category FPO and FPPO records, even when users do not have permission for those categories. This results in unauthorized visibility.
The business requires that FPO and FPPO records be shown strictly based on the user’s category permissions.
Key Needs:
• Users should see only FPO and FPPO records for the categories they are allowed to access.
• Categories outside the user’s permission must be completely hidden from view.
• Category dropdowns and filters must display only permitted categories

chunks.title: Section 2. 📘Scope
chunks.heading: Section 2. 📘Scope
chunks.text:
• The system will show FPO, FPPO and Job Order only for the categories a user has permission to see.
• The Production order list , New FPO List and Job Order screens will hide all other categories.

chunks.title: Section 3. 📌Assumptions
chunks.heading: Section 3. 📌Assumptions
chunks.text:
• Users already have category permissions assigned in the system.
• Every FPO and FPPO record is linked to a specific category.

chunks.title: Section 4. 🛠️Solution
chunks.heading: Section 4. 🛠️Solution
chunks.text:
To ensure users only see the FPO and FPPO they are allowed to view, category permission-based filtering will be applied to the FPO and FPPO screens.
• Only FPO and FPPO records from categories the user has category permission for will be shown.
• Categories that the user does not have access to will be completely hidden.
Acceptance Criteria:
• Users should only see FPO and FPPO records for the categories they have permission to access.
• Any category outside the user’s permission must be completely hidden from the screen.
• The category dropdown and search filters must show only the categories the user is allowed to view.
